claims.text: The conceptual model in Figure 2 was developed using Braun & Clarke's six-phase thematic analysis, which helped identify and organize themes from qualitative data.
The authors added additional explanations and improvements to the conceptual framework to clarify the flow of Edcraft Gamified Learning (EGL) activities, which contributed to the model's development.
The thematic analysis results led to the categorization of four key themes related to recycling intention, which are reflected in the conceptual model.
